C97.name: Migration for Employment Convention (Revised)
key_principles: Equal treatment of migrant workers in respect of remuneration, hours, holidays, social security.
Provision of free services for migrant workers including assistance with information.

C143.name: Migrant Workers (Supplementary Provisions) Convention
key_principles: Suppression of clandestine movements and illegal employment of migrants.
Equality of opportunity and treatment for legally resident migrant workers.

C181.name: Private Employment Agencies Convention
key_principles: Private employment agencies shall not charge any fees or costs to workers, directly or indirectly.
Protection of workers using private employment agencies.

C189.name: Domestic Workers Convention
key_principles: Equal treatment of domestic workers in working hours, weekly rest, paid annual leave.
At least 24 consecutive hours of weekly rest.
Protection from abuse, harassment, and violence.
Right to keep personal documents in one's possession.
Information on terms and conditions of employment in a language the worker understands.

C190.name: Violence and Harassment Convention
key_principles: Right to a world of work free from violence and harassment, including gender-based violence.

fair_recruitment_initiative.name: ILO Fair Recruitment Initiative — General Principles and Operational Guidelines
key_principles: No recruitment fees or related costs should be charged to workers.
Workers must have written employment contracts in a language they understand before departure.
Workers retain freedom of movement and right to terminate employment.

asean_standard_contract.name: ASEAN Rights-Based Standard Employment Contract (research compilation)
key_principles: Employer bears all recruitment-related costs.
Worker keeps own identity documents.
Defined working hours and at least one weekly rest day.
Wages paid on time, in full, directly to the worker.
Right to terminate without loss of repatriation.
